gameId.title: Game ID
gameId.description: Business game identifier stored in vls_gameid. Example: d7a8e927-0488-4a81-ae64-f1d5032dec86.

conversationId.title: Conversation ID
conversationId.description: Existing participant conversation ID, or __NEW__ only when that participant has no persisted conversation yet.

participantSlot.title: Participant slot
participantSlot.description: Agent-owned participant slot: A or B.

requestPhase.title: Request phase
requestPhase.description: recommend for analysis only, or commit with an app-validated payload.

commitPayload.title: Validated commit payload
commitPayload.description: For recommend, optional Canvas rejection feedback JSON for the previous illegal/stale agent recommendation. For commit, app-validated payload.
